column1: # The partition table WLED ships on 4 MB ESP32 boards (WLED_ESP32_4MB_1MB_FS.csv):
# two app slots of 0x180000 = 1 572 864 bytes each.
# The gledopto_* environments are built against it so that PlatformIO's size
# check uses the slot size the board really has. It is never written to that
# board: a firmware installed over the air replaces one app slot and nothing

column2: so the bootloader and this table stay as WLED's installer left them.
